title: Sense the Shift: Business and Imagination, with Phoebe Tickell
description: How might business help shape the future rather than only react to it? A live conversation on growing the imagination to question inherited systems and design more regenerative, participatory organisations, with Phoebe Tickell, founder of Moral Imaginations. Thursday 17 December 2026, 6:30pm GMT (10:30am Pacific), about 90 minutes; Online; £35 for a one-talk pass, as listed on their page. Offered by ESSENSE Business School. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
